Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly extract the place of death from the authoritative source (IMDb) it accessed. In Step 2, the WebSurfer explicitly retrieved the IMDb biography page which clearly stated "He died on 4 August 1995 in Rome, Lazio, Italy." However, in its subsequent analysis (Step 3), the agent incorrectly claimed that the English Wikipedia snippet showed the death location as "Los Angeles, California, USA." This contradicts the actual text visible in the viewport of the Wikipedia page provided in Step 3, which clearly lists "Rome, Lazio, Italy." This error represents a failure to accurately read and report the data from the source it successfully accessed, leading to a false conflict between sources that did not exist in the retrieved data.
